data.gender_notes: Aafak is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Horizons; the far reaches (plural of ufuq)
data.long_meaning: Variant spelling of Arabic āfāq (آفاق), the plural of ufuq 'horizon', from the root ʾ-f-q. Aafak therefore means “Horizons; the far reaches (plural of ufuq)”. Arabic plural āfāq 'horizons'; spelling variant of Aafaaq.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aafak expresses “Unknown, hidden”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Variant spelling of Arabic āfāq (آفاق), the plural of ufuq 'horizon', from the root ʾ-f-q.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aafak total 11, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

faq.q: Is Aafak the same name as Aafaaq?
faq.a: Yes - Aafak, Aafaq and Aafaaq are English spellings of the same Arabic plural آفاق, meaning 'horizons'.

faq.q: What does the name Aafak mean?
faq.a: Aafak means “Horizons; the far reaches (plural of ufuq)”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aafak come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aafak?
faq.a: The root of Aafak is أ-ف-ق (ʾ-f-q).

faq.q: How is Aafak written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aafak is written آفاق in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aafak a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aafak is used as a male name.

faq.q: Does Aafak appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aafak is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aafak verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Horizons; the far reaches (plural of ufuq)” is established by Arabic plural āfāq 'horizons'; spelling variant of Aafaaq..
